answer: Quadratic slashing commitments enforce non-linear asset erosion, anchoring the burden of malicious coordination to a massive wharf of unrecoverable staking collateral. This framework drives marginal attack costs to scale super-linearly against Sybil clusters, ensuring that the dawn of any large-scale exploit faces insurmountable economic barriers. Since the expected utility of captured nectar is dwarfed by the escalating capital expenditure, the protocol maintains a robust Nash equilibrium through guaranteed negative payoffs.
